goal: Snapshot the state/ directory into out/state.tgz with /usr/bin/tar (gzip, COPYFILE_DISABLE=1, LANG=C), confirm the archive is non-empty with file.inspect, then stage exactly one POST intent to the supplied endpoint binding with a JSON body announcing the snapshot. Do not attempt to dispatch. Return a record { bytes: <archive byte count>, staged: <the http.stage state> }.
notes: The endpoint binding names a local fixture HTTP server. http.stage never crosses the wire; only a supervisor Outbox commit dispatches.
http.stage returns { state, action, emission_id, method, endpoint, hold_millis }.
